source: Colima 0.10.3 (Lima 2.3.0, vz), dockerd 29.5.2, containerd image store; installed briefly for this check
dmx: main after 0.4.8, installed v0.4.8 guest, throwaway DMX_HOME, dockerd 29.9.2

manual_run.project: postgres:17-alpine with a named volume and a table row, redis:7-alpine with its anonymous /data and a key, a built image, two networks, a published port; plus a standalone container and a volume with uid 999 files, mode 700, a hard link and a symlink
manual_run.result: all imported; compose up -d started all three services without recreating; row, key, owners, modes and links present; a second run reported all 13 as already in dmx
